title: H3 15 s (720p)
description: One 15-second MiniMax H3 video at 720p with sound: three 5-second parts from three prompts, each starting where the last ended, joined. About 9 minutes at 30 steps.

labels.110:image: First frame: the video starts on this exact image
labels.120:value: Sharpen the first frame with SeedVR2 (turn off with no first frame)

hints: Repeat the same scene description in all three prompts (who, where, camera) and change only the one small action and the line of each part.
The first frame decides the look of the whole video: give a good one.
